// Single-entry server for Render (Web Service). No npm install needed.
// The built app is embedded below (gzip + base64); it is unpacked into a temp folder on start.
// Enhanced with: login page, Telegram bot API, 2D-only mode, custom profile config
import http from "node:http";
import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import zlib from "node:zlib";
import crypto from "node:crypto";
import { Readable } from "node:stream";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const BUNDLE_B64 = "";

const ROOT = path.join(os.tmpdir(), "rbx-app");

// ---- unpack bundle ----
const bundle = JSON.parse(zlib.gunzipSync(Buffer.from(BUNDLE_B64, "base64")).toString());
fs.rmSync(ROOT, { recursive: true, force: true });
for (const [rel, b64] of Object.entries(bundle)) {
  const out = path.join(ROOT, rel);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(out), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(out, Buffer.from(b64, "base64"));
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(ROOT, "package.json"), '{"type":"module"}');

const STATIC_DIR = path.join(ROOT, "static");
const app = (await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(ROOT, "server", "index.mjs")).href)).default;

const MIME = {
  ".html": "text/html; charset=utf-8", ".js": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8", ".mjs": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8",
  ".css": "text/css; charset=utf-8", ".json": "application/json", ".svg": "image/svg+xml", ".png": "image/png",
  ".jpg": "image/jpeg", ".jpeg": "image/jpeg", ".webp": "image/webp", ".gif": "image/gif", ".ico": "image/x-icon",
  ".woff": "font/woff", ".woff2": "font/woff2", ".webmanifest": "application/manifest+json", ".txt": "text/plain",
};

// ---- CONFIG STORE ----
const CONFIG_FILE = path.join(os.tmpdir(), "rbx-config.json");
const KEYS_FILE = path.join(os.tmpdir(), "rbx-keys.json");

function loadJSON(fp, def) {
  try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(fp, "utf8")); } catch { return def; }
}
function saveJSON(fp, data) {
  try { fs.writeFileSync(fp, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)); } catch(e) { console.error("saveJSON:", e); }
}

let CONFIG = loadJSON(CONFIG_FILE, {
  profileUsername: "Builderman",
  profileDisplayName: "Builderman",
  robuxBalance: 150000,
  itemName: "Headless Horseman",
  itemPrice: 31000,
  adminToken: process.env.ADMIN_TOKEN || crypto.randomBytes(16).toString("hex"),
});
let KEYS = loadJSON(KEYS_FILE, {});

console.log("\n=== RBX Admin Token:", CONFIG.adminToken, "===\n");

function saveConfig() { saveJSON(CONFIG_FILE, CONFIG); }
function saveKeys() { saveJSON(KEYS_FILE, KEYS); }

function generateKey() {
  const p = () => crypto.randomBytes(3).toString("hex").toUpperCase();
  return "cc-" + p() + "-" + p() + "-__" + p();
}

function tryStatic(urlPath, res) {
  let rel;
  try { rel = decodeURIComponent(urlPath); } catch { return false; }
  const file = path.normalize(path.join(STATIC_DIR, rel));
  if (!file.startsWith(STATIC_DIR + path.sep)) return false;
  let st;
  try { st = fs.statSync(file); } catch { return false; }
  if (!st.isFile()) return false;
  res.writeHead(200, {
    "content-type": MIME[path.extname(file).toLowerCase()] || "application/octet-stream",
    "content-length": st.size,
    "cache-control": rel.startsWith("/assets/") ? "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" : "public, max-age=3600",
  });
  fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(res);
  return true;
}

async function readBody(req) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const chunks = [];
    req.on("data", c => chunks.push(c));
    req.on("end", () => resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8")));
    req.on("error", reject);
  });
}

async function parseBody(req) {
  const raw = await readBody(req);
  const ct = req.headers["content-type"] || "";
  if (ct.includes("application/json")) {
    try { return JSON.parse(raw); } catch { return {}; }
  }
  const params = {};
  for (const pair of raw.split("&")) {
    const eq = pair.indexOf("=");
    if (eq === -1) continue;
    const k = decodeURIComponent(pair.slice(0, eq).replace(/\+/g, " "));
    const v = decodeURIComponent(pair.slice(eq + 1).replace(/\+/g, " "));
    params[k] = v;
  }
  return params;
}

function getSessionKey(req) {
  const cookie = req.headers.cookie || "";
  const m = cookie.match(/rbx-session=([^;]+)/);
  return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : null;
}

function injectConfig(html, keyData) {
  const cfg = keyData || {};
  const configObj = {
    profileUsername: cfg.profileUsername || CONFIG.profileUsername,
    profileDisplayName: cfg.profileDisplayName || CONFIG.profileDisplayName,
    robuxBalance: cfg.robuxBalance != null ? cfg.robuxBalance : CONFIG.robuxBalance,
    itemName: cfg.itemName || CONFIG.itemName,
    itemPrice: cfg.itemPrice != null ? cfg.itemPrice : CONFIG.itemPrice,
    expiresAt: cfg.expiresAt != null ? Number(cfg.expiresAt) : 0,
  };
  const cfgScript = "<script>window.__RBX_CONFIG__=" + JSON.stringify(configObj) + ";<\/script>";
  return html.replace("</head>", cfgScript + INJECT_SCRIPT + "</head>");
}

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const url = new URL(req.url, "http://" + (req.headers.host || "localhost"));
    const pathname = url.pathname;

    // LOGIN PAGE
    if (pathname === "/login" || pathname === "/login/") {
      if (req.method === "GET") {
        const errMsg = url.searchParams.get("error") || "";
        const html = buildLoginPage(errMsg);
        res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" });
        return res.end(html);
      }
    }

    // VERIFY KEY
    if (pathname === "/api/verify-key" && req.method === "POST") {
      const body = await parseBody(req);
      const key = (body.key || "").trim();
      const kd = KEYS[key];
      if (!kd) {
        res.writeHead(302, { location: "/login?error=Invalid+key" });
        return res.end();
      }
      if (kd.used) {
        res.writeHead(302, { location: "/login?error=Key+already+used" });
        return res.end();
      }
      if (kd.expiresAt && Date.now() > kd.expiresAt) {
        res.writeHead(302, { location: "/login?error=Key+has+expired" });
        return res.end();
      }
      KEYS[key].used = true;
      KEYS[key].usedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      saveKeys();
      const maxAge = kd.expiresAt ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil((kd.expiresAt - Date.now()) / 1000)) : 86400;
      res.writeHead(302, {
        location: "/",
        "cache-control": "no-store",
        "set-cookie": "rbx-session=" + encodeURIComponent(key) + "; Path=/; HttpOnly; Max-Age=" + maxAge + "; SameSite=Lax",
      });
      return res.end();
    }

    // BOT API: CREATE KEY
    if (pathname === "/api/bot/create-key" && req.method === "POST") {
      const body = await parseBody(req);
      if (body.admin_token !== CONFIG.adminToken) {
        res.writeHead(403, { "content-type": "application/json" });
        return res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: "Forbidden" }));
      }
      const key = generateKey();
      const requestedExpiresAt = Number(body.expiresAt);
      const expiresInHours = Number(body.expiresInHours);
      const normalizedExpiresAt = Number.isFinite(requestedExpiresAt) && requestedExpiresAt > Date.now()
        ? requestedExpiresAt
        : (Number.isFinite(expiresInHours) && expiresInHours > 0 ? Date.now() + expiresInHours * 3600000 : null);
      const keyConfig = {
        profileUsername: body.profileUsername || CONFIG.profileUsername,
        profileDisplayName: body.profileDisplayName || CONFIG.profileDisplayName,
        robuxBalance: parseInt(body.robuxBalance) || CONFIG.robuxBalance,
        itemName: body.itemName || CONFIG.itemName,
        itemPrice: parseInt(body.itemPrice) || CONFIG.itemPrice,
        recipientTg: body.recipientTg || "",
        used: false,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        expiresAt: normalizedExpiresAt,
      };
      KEYS[key] = keyConfig;
      saveKeys();
      res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "application/json" });
      return res.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, key, config: keyConfig }));
    }

    // BOT API: LIST KEYS
    if (pathname === "/api/bot/keys" && req.method === "GET") {
      if (url.searchParams.get("admin_token") !== CONFIG.adminToken) {
        res.writeHead(403, { "content-type": "application/json" });
        return res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: "Forbidden" }));
      }
      res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "application/json" });
      return res.end(JSON.stringify({ keys: KEYS }));
    }

    // BOT API: UPDATE CONFIG
    if (pathname === "/api/bot/update-config" && req.method === "POST") {
      const body = await parseBody(req);
      if (body.admin_token !== CONFIG.adminToken) {
        res.writeHead(403, { "content-type": "application/json" });
        return res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: "Forbidden" }));
      }
      if (body.profileUsername) CONFIG.profileUsername = body.profileUsername;
      if (body.profileDisplayName) CONFIG.profileDisplayName = body.profileDisplayName;
      if (body.robuxBalance) CONFIG.robuxBalance = parseInt(body.robuxBalance);
      if (body.itemName) CONFIG.itemName = body.itemName;
      if (body.itemPrice) CONFIG.itemPrice = parseInt(body.itemPrice);
      saveConfig();
      res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "application/json" });
      return res.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, config: CONFIG }));
    }

    // SESSION STATUS / EXPIRE SESSION
    if (pathname === "/api/session-status" && req.method === "GET") {
      const sessionKey = getSessionKey(req);
      const kd = sessionKey ? KEYS[sessionKey] : null;
      if (!kd) {
        res.writeHead(401, { "content-type": "application/json", "cache-control": "no-store" });
        return res.end(JSON.stringify({ valid: false, expired: false }));
      }
      if (kd.expiresAt && Date.now() >= kd.expiresAt) {
        res.writeHead(401, {
          "content-type": "application/json",
          "cache-control": "no-store",
          "set-cookie": "rbx-session=; Path=/; HttpOnly; Max-Age=0; SameSite=Lax",
        });
        return res.end(JSON.stringify({ valid: false, expired: true }));
      }
      res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "application/json", "cache-control": "no-store" });
      return res.end(JSON.stringify({ valid: true, expiresAt: kd.expiresAt || null }));
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/expire-session" && (req.method === "POST" || req.method === "GET")) {
      res.writeHead(200, {
        "content-type": "application/json",
        "cache-control": "no-store",
        "set-cookie": "rbx-session=; Path=/; HttpOnly; Max-Age=0; SameSite=Lax",
      });
      return res.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: true }));
    }

    // SESSION CHECK
    const sessionKey = getSessionKey(req);
    const keyData = sessionKey ? KEYS[sessionKey] : null;
    const keysExist = Object.keys(KEYS).length > 0;
    const isExpiredSession = !!(keyData && keyData.expiresAt && Date.now() >= keyData.expiresAt);
    if (isExpiredSession && !pathname.startsWith("/login") && !pathname.startsWith("/api/") && !pathname.startsWith("/assets/") && !pathname.startsWith("/__grok")) {
      res.writeHead(302, {
        location: "/login?error=Key+has+expired",
        "cache-control": "no-store",
        "set-cookie": "rbx-session=; Path=/; HttpOnly; Max-Age=0; SameSite=Lax",
      });
      return res.end();
    }
    const isProtected = keysExist
      && !keyData
      && !pathname.startsWith("/login")
      && !pathname.startsWith("/api/")
      && !pathname.startsWith("/assets/")
      && !pathname.startsWith("/__grok");
    if (isProtected) {
      res.writeHead(302, { location: "/login", "cache-control": "no-store" });
      return res.end();
    }

    // STATIC FILES
    if ((req.method === "GET" || req.method === "HEAD") && tryStatic(url.pathname, res)) return;

    // SSR APP
    const proto = req.headers["x-forwarded-proto"] || "http";
    const hasBody = !["GET", "HEAD"].includes(req.method);
    const request = new Request(new URL(req.url, proto + "://" + req.headers.host), {
      method: req.method,
      headers: req.headers,
      body: hasBody ? Readable.toWeb(req) : undefined,
      duplex: hasBody ? "half" : undefined,
    });
    const response = await app.fetch(request, { waitUntil() {} });

    const headers = {};
    response.headers.forEach((v, k) => { if (k !== "set-cookie") headers[k] = v; });
    const cookies = response.headers.getSetCookie?.() ?? [];
    if (cookies.length) headers["set-cookie"] = cookies;

    // INJECT INTO HTML
    const ct = headers["content-type"] || "";
    if (ct.includes("text/html") && response.body) {
      const chunks = [];
      const reader = response.body.getReader();
      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        chunks.push(Buffer.from(value));
      }
      let html = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8");
      html = injectConfig(html, keyData);
      const buf = Buffer.from(html, "utf8");
      headers["content-length"] = String(buf.length);
      if (keyData) headers["cache-control"] = "no-store, private";
      delete headers["transfer-encoding"];
      res.writeHead(response.status, headers);
      return res.end(buf);
    }

    res.writeHead(response.status, headers);
    if (!response.body || req.method === "HEAD") return res.end();
    Readable.fromWeb(response.body).pipe(res);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
    if (!res.headersSent) res.writeHead(500, { "content-type": "text/plain" });
    res.end("Internal Server Error");
  }
});

const port = Number(process.env.PORT) || 10000;
server.listen(port, "0.0.0.0", () => console.log("Listening on :" + port));
